en:
Digital In

Introduction

The digital_in class allows the V5 Brain to read a digital signal from an external source, such as a switch or sensor. It detects whether the input line is high, receiving 5 volts, or low, receiving 0 volts. This can be used to determine on/off states or trigger events in a project.

Class Constructors

digital_in(
  triport::port &port );

Class Destructor

Destroys the digital_in object and releases associated resources.

~digital_in();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
port triport::port & The 3-Wire Port that the Digital Input device is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X, where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A).

Example

// Create the digital_in instance on 3-Wire Port A
digital_in digin = digital_in(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

Member Functions

The digital_in class includes the following member functions:

  • value — Returns whether the Digital In port is receiving a high or low signal.
  • high — Registers a function to be called whenever the Digital In device sends a high signal.
  • low — Registers a function to be called whenever the Digital In device sends a low signal.

Before calling any digital_in member functions, a digital_in instance must be created, as shown below:

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Digital input configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the digital_in instance on 3-Wire Port A
digital_in DigitalInA = digital_in(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

value

Returns whether the Digital In port is receiving a high or low signal.

Available Functions

int32_t value();

Parameters

This function does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t representing the current digital signal state:

  • 1 – The Digital In port is receiving a high signal (approximately 5V).
  • 0 – The Digital In port is receiving a low signal (approximately 0V).

high

Registers a function to be called whenever the Digital In device sends a high signal (approximately 5V).

Available Functions

void high(
  void (* callback)(void) );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
callback void (* callback)(void) A function that will be called when the input is high.

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Examples

Define the callback function (outside of int main())

// Display that the input is high
void inputHigh() {
  Brain.Screen.print("digital input high");
}

Register the callback inside int main()

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run inputHigh when the Digital Input is high
  DigitalInA.high(inputHigh);
}

low

Registers a function to be called whenever the Digital In device sends a low signal (approximately 0V).

Available Functions

void low(
  void (* callback)(void) );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
callback void (* callback)(void) A function that will be called when the input is low.

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Examples

Define the callback function (outside of int main())

// Display that the input is low
void inputLow() {
  Brain.Screen.print("digital input low");
}

Register the callback inside int main()

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run inputLow when the Digital Input is low
  DigitalInA.low(inputLow);
}
zh:
数字输入

概述

digital_in类允许 V5 主控器从外部源读取数字信号，例如开关或传感器。它检测输入线是否为高电平（接收 5 伏）或低电平（接收 0 伏）。这可用于确定项目中的开/关状态或触发事件。

构造函数

digital_in(
  triport::port &port );

析构函数

销毁digital_in对象并释放关联资源。

~digital_in();

参数

参数 类型 说明
port triport::port & 数字输入设备连接的三线端口，写作Brain.ThreeWirePort.X或ExpanderName.X，其中X是端口号（例如，Brain.ThreeWirePort.A或Expander1.A）。

示例

// Create the digital_in instance on 3-Wire Port A
digital_in digin = digital_in(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

成员函数

digital_in类包含以下成员函数：

  • value— 返回数字输入端口是否正在接收高信号或低信号。
  • high— 注册一个在数字输入设备发送高电平信号时调用的函数。
  • low— 注册一个在数字输入设备发送低信号时调用的函数。

在调用任何digital_in成员函数之前，必须创建一个digital_in实例，如下所示：

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Digital input configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the digital_in instance on 3-Wire Port A
digital_in DigitalInA = digital_in(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

value

返回数字输入端口是否正在接收高信号或低信号。

函数重载

int32_t value();

参数

该函数不接受任何参数。

返回值

返回表示当前数字信号状态的int32_t：

  • 1– 数字输入端口正在接收高信号（大约 5V）。
  • 0– 数字输入端口正在接收低信号（大约 0V）。

high

注册一个函数，每当数字输入设备发送高信号（大约 5V）时调用。

函数重载

void high(
  void (* callback)(void) );

参数

参数 类型 说明
callback void (* callback)(void) 当输入为高电平时将调用的函数。

返回值

此函数无返回值。

示例

定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

// Display that the input is high
void inputHigh() {
  Brain.Screen.print("digital input high");
}

在int main()内部注册回调函数

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run inputHigh when the Digital Input is high
  DigitalInA.high(inputHigh);
}

low

注册一个函数，每当数字输入设备发送低信号（大约 0V）时调用。

函数重载

void low(
  void (* callback)(void) );

参数

参数 类型 说明
callback void (* callback)(void) 当输入较低时将调用的函数。

返回值

此函数无返回值。

示例

定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

// Display that the input is low
void inputLow() {
  Brain.Screen.print("digital input low");
}

在int main()内部注册回调函数

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run inputLow when the Digital Input is low
  DigitalInA.low(inputLow);
}
